explanation: W = 1.45 GeV is below the eta-proton production threshold for ep -> e'p(eta), so this kinematic point is physically inaccessible regardless of Q2, cos(theta*), or phi*. The threshold is W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.547860 = 1.486132 GeV (exclurad.F hardcodes amp=0.938272 GeV and amhad(2)=0.54786 GeV for the eta; mpintp.inc's EtaMAID-2023 grid likewise starts at W=1.4856 GeV, i.e. threshold). At W=1.45 GeV there isn't even enough invariant mass to produce a proton and an eta at rest, let alone with relative momentum, so no value of cos(theta*)/phi* rescues this point -- the two-body phase space is empty. Being 'above the Delta' (W~1.232 GeV) is irrelevant here: the Delta resonance sits well below the eta channel's opening, and pion-production thresholds do not apply to this reaction. No EXCLURAD input file was generated. To proceed, request a W at or above ~1.487 GeV (the lowest tabulated point in the EtaMAID-2023 grid used by this code).
